data.headline: Manager - ITS at Werner Enterprises
data.about:
Throughout my career, I have been a “change agent” with strong beliefs in integrity, agility, practical and cost-effective business solutions through technology, with a commitment to driving to best practice and service-based principles. 

Ability to effectively engage with executive and business stakeholders to build and foster relationships
Highly motivated, self-starter and problem solver with strong analytical, organizational and team building skills
Extensive experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into well-designed reliable business solutions in a fast paced technical and business environment.
Detailed oriented with the ability to focus on achieving overall goals and objectives, while managing multiple priorities, tasks and personnel. Work closely with business partners and executive stakeholders to ensure IT efforts are properly aligned with business priorities and strategic initiatives. 
Excellent presentation, communication and effective negotiation skills.

Milestones

Challenged to construct the vision that would activate a cultural shift in organizational thinking relating to data management.
Charged with constructing and deploying the first Enterprise Data Management Accountability framework. 
Partnered with Enterprise Information Management to establish a Data Management Governance Structure and operating model.

In my free time, I enjoy spending time with my wife and two Weimaraner’s., I am an active member of the Knights of Columbus, Catholic Men’s Fellowship and Eucharistic Minister. I am a sports enthusiast, enjoy spending time outdoors, walking, camping, barbecuing, and relaxing in the patio.

description.text: Directly manage one or more Information Technology teams of technical, analytical and development staff members responsible for the organization's applications, infrastructure, development, and analysis functions.

Provides strategic business analysts services to business partners by understanding existing processes and making recommendations on process improvements through technology. Serve as a liaison between ITS and user department(s). This includes working closely with internal departments to clearly understand and address business problems and issues. Responsible for the delivery of complex projects to the client and/or internal organizations. This includes insuring clients and other departments actively participate in appropriate phases of the process, such as requirements definition and quality inspections of design documents. Understand processes, how systems are being used, and system development methodologies are followed and continuously improved.

experiences.subtitle: Technicolor . undefined
experiences.caption: May 2016 - Jun 2017 · 1 yr 1 mo

description.text:
Collaborated with our AP Accountants and vendors to identify and resolve purchase order discrepancies. Produced various reports for management including accounts payable registers, Bi-weekly cash forecast and analysis. Met regularly with Site Controllers from all Business Units on reoccurring issues with compliance and spend analysis. 
•	Created and analyzed monthly KPI reporting for AP, GL, Billing and Cash Application departments for trends with compliance
•	Planned/lead/collaborated with 18 AP Accountants to reduce cost of invoice process discrepancies. Identified/implemented controls to reduce the number of discrepancies by 15% in 4 months
•	Acted as Project Manager for all system UAT requirements pertaining to the AP department, completing projects on time and on budget
•	Transitioned manual operational time reporting to automated 3rd party time reporting application in 5 months
•	Prepared and presented process documentation, visual aids and other education material for the transition training of Financial Shared Services department to Guadalajara Mexico 
•	Primary point of contact for all internal and external Audit requests, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Completed documentation on all assigned systems and databases, including business rules, logic, and processes. Created Test data and Test Cases documentation for regression and performance. Supported data governance, integrity, quality, and audit functions. IT Broker for small to mid-sized projects
•	Contributed in the design/integration and implementation of Data Information Steward reporting tool to provide process Score Card metrics for Sales, Customer Service and Data Management organizations
•	Project Management - planned/oversaw/collaborated with 6 cross-functional departments to deliver approximately 26 annual product releases on time and within budget
•	Provided on-going support for modification and debugging of product material and product pricing, resulting in a major reduction of production system down time
•	Review/address/reconcile product materials with Product Management Teams to identify stale, slow moving and obsolete materials. Resulting is a 30% reduction of materials
•	Designed/administered customer survey to assess/monitor quality of service delivery. Successfully addressed issues to improve ratings by 25% in the first 6 months
•	Developed intermediate business knowledge of the functional area and processed to understand the application of data information to support business function
•	Identified Opportunities for Improvement (OFI), recommended and implemented as applicable, processed improvement plan in collaboration with identified department

Contributed to a multi-million-dollar System Conversion for - I led the Procurement, Supply Chain efforts through the entire System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) - Planning, Design, Testing, Implementation, and Post-Implementation Support for a North-America-wide, multi-site, multi-rollout, installation of SAP ERP. I assumed the various roles of Change Agent, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Trainer, & Support Lead over the 6-Year life of the project. I know how to tailor my communications verbal and written, in-person & online to audiences from Front-line Employees, Supervisors, Managers to Senior Executives.
•	5 successful go-live implementations spanning multiple legal entities and rollout sites over a 4-year period
•	Developed and presented training on SAP ECC and SAP CRM in classroom, online and telepresence settings for approximately 300 people. Resulting in significant company savings
•	Coordinated, resolved and responded to 200-300 service tickets in a 5-day turnaround measurably improving customer satisfaction
•	Performed production support and optimization activities working closely with developers and the business users and non-production support for project teams
•	Developed and updated handbook documentation to ensure that all procedures are documented and repeatable
•	Developed strong cross-team relationships with business and technical teams 
•	Improved environment by identifying opportunities and recommended solutions for improving service efficiency and effectiveness

Oversaw driver, dispatch and admin personnel. Interfaced with internal and external customers to answer inquiries and resolve issues and observations. Completed month-end operations along with costing and billing reports. Managed AP/AR process.
•	Analyzed daily operational metrics to monitor operational efficiency, equipment utilization, performance and profitability
•	Drove innovation and adoption of new technology that resulted in improved financial performance for the division and business
•	Verified accounts and resolved account discrepancies by reconciling/ reviewing reconciliation of statements/transactions and investigating documentation

Implement strategies and provide the leadership necessary to meet established goals and support the company’s core values. Responsible for financial performance, client competitive rankings, compliance, training/coaching and collection strategies.

Manage and monitors the key metrics as established by ownership for proactive implementation of solutions (e.g. month over month collection, back log days, AR aging buckets, etc.) Work with the team to develop best demonstrated practices for the area including but not limited to workflow process improvements, efficiencies and effectiveness in dealing with the daily AR and denial management of the team.

Develop the productivity and quality benchmarks for the team members to support the management goals for the department as well as holding individual contributors accountable. Provide coordination of collections of revenue and/or payments processing by collecting and/or overseeing the collection of revenue and the clearing of delinquent accounts.

description.text:
Senior Credit Analyst
Responsible for reviewing applications, credit reports, bank statements and financials to determine credit worthiness. Assemble a credit package and submit to the Credit Manager for credit limit and credit approval.    

Account Payable Supervisor
Review accounts payable processing and cash disbursements insuring timeliness, accuracy and the validity of each expense. Verify the expense distribution for accurate general ledger account assignment. Coordinate accrued liability computation insuring the expenses are stated in the proper month, giving accurate reporting to management of the total monthly liabilities.
